attractions.name: Tsuglagkhang Complex (Dalai Lama Temple)
attractions.description: Official residence of the Dalai Lama, with temples, prayer halls, monasteries and prayer wheels.
attractions._source_file: North India/Mr. Amit Sinkar- North India- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: McLeod Ganj
attractions.description: Vibrant town known as "Little Lhasa" for its Tibetan influence, with handicraft shops, monasteries, bakeries and cafés.
attractions._source_file: North India/Mr. Amit Sinkar- North India- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Bhagsu Nag Temple
attractions.description: Ancient temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, believed to be more than 500 years old, with a small sacred pool.
attractions._source_file: North India/Mr. Amit Sinkar- North India- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Bhagsu Waterfall
attractions.description: Waterfall cascading down rocky cliffs, reached by a 10–15 minute walk from Bhagsu Nag Temple past cafés and shops.
tips: Flows beautifully in spring and early summer
attractions._source_file: North India/Mr. Amit Sinkar- North India- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Dal Lake Dharamshala
attractions.description: Small peaceful lake surrounded by deodar cedars with walking paths and a nearby Shiva temple.
attractions._source_file: North India/Mr. Amit Sinkar- North India- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Naddi View Point
attractions.description: Peaceful viewpoint with clear views of the snow-capped Dhauladhar range, especially at sunset.
attractions._source_file: North India/Mr. Amit Sinkar- North India- All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: St. John in the Wilderness Church
